title: Kowloon Rising Again
author: Rosalind Ashgrove
blurb: Yara Whitlock, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
